result: FAIL, deterministic reproduction of r388 (reproducibility control).
why_it_ran: launch-round.py --drop-extra only strips keys from the inherited payload-command --extra-arg list; r388's payload builder had already written e5-frameinfo=0 into the baseline boot_b EFI/UniXNU/unixnu.toml args, and the r389 baseline was the device's post-r388 boot_b, so the value was inherited. Documented in uefi/build/sb-r389-frameinfo-default/launch-correction.json and kept as a control.

evidence.same_failure_signature_as_r388: main render client fi=0 all round; source_rgb never exceeded ~8k px; FRAMEROW ids 300-317 only; zero synthetic transitions; fps 19 presents mean 0.53 (r388: 22 presents mean 0.56).
evidence.shader_variance_note: Same binaries as r388 yet compile costs differ per run (max 4.9s vs r388's 15.5s; r390 saw 19.4s) - multi-second compiles are a distribution, not fixed costs; per-run order varies.
